author: Ari Koslow
title: Mitch Bratt expected to start Sunday
desc: Mitch Bratt is expected to be called up to start on Sunday for the Diamondbacks.
impact: Bratt made his MLB debut in late June, giving up just one run on two hits and two walks while striking out three over three innings in a start against the Cardinals. Zac Gallen was scratched from his scheduled start on Sunday and is expected to be placed on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zac Gallen (elbow) to likely be placed on IL
desc: The Diamondbacks are expected to place Zac Gallen on the injured list.
impact: Gallen was scratched from his scheduled start on Sunday with right elbow inflammation. There could be an official move announced on Sunday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Blake Snell (elbow) to begin rehab assignment next week
desc: Blake Snell will begin a rehab assignment next week.
impact: Snell threw two innings to hitters on Saturday. He is expected to require at least four rehab outings.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yoshinobu Yamamoto will not pitch in All-Star game
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Yoshinobu Yamamoto will not pitch in the All-Star Game.
impact: Yamamoto will rest during the week of the All-Star game. He is starting on Saturday against the Diamondbacks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Matt Waldron activated from IL
desc: The Padres activated RHP Matt Waldron from the 15-day injured list.
impact: Waldron returns to the Padres in a relief role following his struggles prior to his injury.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jhony Brito optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Padres optioned RHP Jhony Brito to Triple-A El Paso.
impact: Brito made two appearances. He will return to Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Landon Knack activated from 60-day IL
desc: The Dodgers activated RHP Landon Knack from the 60-day injured list.
impact: Knack made three appearances on his rehab assignment. He will return in a long relief role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Hurt optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Dodgers optioned RHP Kyle Hurt to Triple-A Oklahoma City.
impact: Hurt will return to Triple-A with Landon Knack activated from the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Charlie Barnes designated for assignment
desc: The Dodgers designated LHP Charlie Barnes for assignment.
impact: Barnes loses his spot on the 40-man roster of the Dodgers. He will head to waivers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yaramil Hiraldo activated from IL, optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Orioles activated RHP Yaramil Hiraldo from the 60-day injured list and optioned him to Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Hiraldo had been sidelined since April with right shoulder inflammation. He will remain in Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Helsley dealing with inflammation around UCL
desc: Ryan Helsley said he has inflammation around his UCL but the ligament itself is intact.
impact: Helsley went for a second opinion on his sore elbow. It is a positive report, though he remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chase Burns dealing with groin soreness
desc: Chase Burns is dealing with groin soreness.
impact: Burnes will look to get healthy during the All-Star break.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kazuma Okamoto blasts three-run homer in win over Padres
desc: Kazuma Okamoto went 1-for-3 in a 5-3 win over the Padres with a three-run home run and one walk.
impact: Okamoto has flashed his power stroke of late, going deep in three of his last four contests. The rookie has offered manager John Schneider one of the more explosive bats while fighting inconsistent stretches at the plate, batting .238 with 22 home runs, 62 RBI, and 49 runs scored through 91 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Louis Varland escapes traffic for save in win over Padres
desc: Louis Varland allowed one earned run on three hits while striking out one to earn the save in Friday's 5-3 win over the Padres.
impact: Varland continues a steady stretch out of the bullpen, holding opponents scoreless in eight of his last 10 contests. The right-hander has offered manager John Schneider an impactful closer option since taking over the role, carrying a 1.10 ERA and 0.98 WHIP with 19 saves, five holds, and a 12.3 K/9 ratio across 44 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Shane Bieber battles control in no-decision
desc: Shane Bieber allowed two earned runs on six hits and three walks while striking out four over 4 2/3 innings in Friday's win over the Padres.
impact: Bieber has offered mixed results on the mound, allowing four earned runs or more in two of his four trips to the mound. The right-hander continues to fight inconsistent command since returning from the injured list for manager John Schneider, posting a 7.64 ERA and 2.04 WHIP with a 0-1 record and 1.3 K/BB ratio through four starts.
